extraction_notes: P-channel quantities are recorded as positive magnitudes for extraction and model fitting; the datasheet publishes the corresponding electrical polarities as negative values.
Transfer, output, capacitance, and source-drain diode curves are approximate digitizations from the typical-characteristics figures on p. 3-4; axes and test conditions are retained.
The datasheet publishes no typical VGS(th) entry, so threshold_typ is null. The guaranteed threshold range is 0.4 V to 1.0 V in magnitude at |ID| = 2.5e-4 A and VDS = VGS.
The RDS(on) table typical values are 0.09 ohm at |VGS| = 4.5 V and |ID| = 2.8 A, and 0.11 ohm at |VGS| = 2.5 V and |ID| = 2.0 A. The corresponding maximum limits are 0.112 ohm and 0.142 ohm.
The capacitance table is specified at |VDS| = 10 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1e6 Hz. The capacitance figure was digitized to retain the voltage-dependent Ciss, Coss, and Crss behavior.

The gate-charge rows are not represented by the supplied schema. Published values are typical 5.5e-9 C at |VGS| = 4.5 V, |VDS| = 10 V, |ID| = 3 A and 3.3e-9 C at |VGS| = 2.5 V, |VDS| = 10 V, |ID| = 3 A, with maximum limits of 1.0e-8 C and 6.0e-9 C respectively.
The body-diode table gives |VSD| limits of 0.8 V minimum and 1.2 V maximum at |IS| = 0.7 A; body_diode uses the 25 degC typical-curve estimate of 0.63 V.
The thermal table publishes RthJA = 120 K/W typical and 145 K/W maximum, and RthJF = 62 K/W typical and 78 K/W maximum; no RthJC value is published.
extraction.omission_reason: The supplied schema has no fields for gate charge, reverse-recovery charge/time, leakage, transconductance, temperature coefficients, or thermal resistance, so those published values are retained only in extraction_notes.
